# SwitchTender

> SwitchTender is a fleet automation control plane that runs from one binary. It runs Ansible,
> Terraform, OpenTofu, Bash, PowerShell, Python, and Go across a fleet, paints
> every run as a live host-by-task matrix, splits big jobs by measured host cost, records a
> tamper-evident audit trail, and imports AWX projects, inventories, templates, surveys, and
> schedules in one command. Every change returns a chain receipt, every run exports an evidence
> dossier, a change register covers each period, an external witness countersigns attestations,
> and the chain exports as a LoomSeal bundle verified offline. State lives in one SQLite file by default, with Postgres optional.
> No Kubernetes, no Redis, no message bus. Source-available under BSL 1.1: the controller, every
> tool, and the full evidence chain are free to self-host with no seat, host, or run limits. Paid
> tiers add what an organization needs around it: SSO, the full policy engine, PostgreSQL and
> active-active HA, distributed workers, drift reconcile, and audit-ready change registers. Each
> release converts to Apache 2.0 two years after it ships.

Install: `go install github.com/kordloom/switchtender@latest`, Homebrew, or release binaries
with SHA256SUMS for Linux, macOS, and Windows at https://github.com/kordloom/switchtender/releases.
Quickstart: run `switchtender serve`, open the browser UI. Try `switchtender demo` for a
seeded read-only tour.

## Start here
- Live demo, read-only and seeded with real runs, nothing to install: https://demo.switchtender.com

- [Homepage](https://switchtender.com/): what it is and the live matrix
- [Pricing](https://switchtender.com/pricing): Community free forever, Pro $490/year for SSO and five approval policies, Team from $4,800/year flat per org by fleet band, Enterprise from $50,000/year for independent witnessing and evidence operations
- [Get started](https://switchtender.com/get-started): install and first run
- [AI agents](https://switchtender.com/agents): give an agent one operator-bound token, gate every run behind human approval, and prove what it did
- [Quickstart](https://switchtender.com/docs/quickstart): first job in minutes
- [FAQ](https://switchtender.com/docs/faq): the questions everyone asks

## Docs

- [Concepts](https://switchtender.com/docs/concepts): jobs, templates, fleets, runs
- [Provable audit](https://switchtender.com/docs/concepts#provable-audit): every mutation is recorded in a fail-closed hash chain before it executes, or refused with a 503
- [Compliance mapping](https://switchtender.com/docs/compliance): the record mapped to SOC 2 CC8.1, ISO 27001 A.8.32, HIPAA 164.312(b)
- [Sample evidence pack](https://switchtender.com/docs/sample-evidence-pack): what a reviewer's sample looks like, produced from a real chain
- Offline verification: signed LoomSeal bundles verify on an air-gapped machine against the key the server publishes at /.well-known/loomseal.json
- Receipts: every mutation returns an Audit-Receipt header (seq:hash) that later proves the chain still holds that exact entry at that exact position
- [Tools](https://switchtender.com/docs/features): Ansible, Terraform, OpenTofu, Bash, PowerShell, Python, Go
- [Reliability](https://switchtender.com/docs/reliability): sharding, retries, drift detection
- [Secrets](https://switchtender.com/docs/secrets)
- [API](https://switchtender.com/docs/api)
- [Benchmarks](https://switchtender.com/docs/benchmarks)

## Company

- [GitHub](https://github.com/kordloom/switchtender)
- SwitchTender is a [KordLoom](https://kordloom.com) product. Its audit exports use
  [LoomSeal](https://loomseal.com), an open format for evidence someone else can check.
